title: Major opening to the primary living space oriented north-west to east with a 3 m x 3 m uncovered area
text: Orientation of major openings (applies to R30-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR and HR only). Note: No orientation provisions apply to primary living areas located in climate zones 1 and 3. C2.2.2 For grouped dwellings(1) in areas coded R30 and above and in climate zones 4,5 and 6, a major opening to the primary living space is oriented between north-west and east in accordance with Figure 2.2b, with an adjoining uncovered open area with: i. a minimum dimension 3m x 3m(2) in accordance with Figure 2.2c; and ii. the exception of shading devices up to 2m depth. (1) Until 10 April 2030, this provision does not apply to single houses located in areas designated with a residential density code of R50 or higher within a structure plan and/or local development plan that was approved prior to 10 April 2024. (2) The centre line of the minimum 3m x 3m area must be contained within the glazed area of the major opening (Figure 2.2d).

parts.label: major opening oriented between north-west and east (Figure 2.2b)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: coding R30 and above plus R100-SL (clause body p17 'grouped dwellings in areas coded R30 and above'; heading adds R100-SL, LR, MR, HR), and no transitional exception. Footnote 1 is attached to 'grouped dwellings' but says the provision does not apply to 'single houses' at R50+ in structure plans or LDPs approved before 10 April 2024; read literally it gives grouped dwellings no relief (register ch3-024: copied from Chapter 2), so the Chapter 2 exception is not carried. If DPLH intends relief for grouped dwellings, restore it. No orientation provisions in climate zones 1 and 3. Area >= 9m2 is the 3 m x 3 m square; centre line within the glazed area (footnote 2).

verified.note: Values match p17 (R30 and above, zones 4-6, NW to E, 3m x 3m, 2m shading). Ambiguous on the page: footnote 1 is attached to 'grouped dwellings' but grants relief only to 'single houses' at R50+ under pre-10 April 2024 structure plans or LDPs, so whether grouped dwellings get any transitional relief is not stated.
